turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Hi doctor. I’ve had a cough, and my nose and the back of my throat feel itchy. I also have nasal congestion with a clear runny nose.
1) How long have these symptoms been going on (hours/days), and do you have a fever?
They’ve been going on for a few days. I don’t have a fever.
2) Is the cough dry or are you bringing up any phlegm/sputum? If yes, what color?
It’s mostly a dry cough. I’m not bringing up any phlegm or sputum.
3) Any shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness?
No shortness of breath, no wheezing, and no chest tightness.
4) Do you have any sore throat or trouble swallowing, or is it mainly an itchy sensation at the back of the throat?
My throat is mostly itchy at the back. I don’t have trouble swallowing.
5) Any hoarseness or change in your voice?
No, I haven’t noticed any hoarseness or voice change.
6) Have you noticed any facial pain/pressure (cheeks/forehead) or thick/yellow-green nasal discharge?
I don’t have facial pain or pressure. And my nasal discharge is clear, not thick or yellow-green.
7) Any known exposure to someone with the flu/COVID, or have you had body aches or fatigue?
I don’t know of any exposure to flu or COVID. I also don’t have body aches or unusual fatigue.
8) Do you have any history of asthma/COPD, or have you ever had similar episodes with cough and runny nose?
I don’t have asthma or COPD myself. But I’ve had similar cough and runny nose episodes before.
9) When you say “similar episodes before,” how often do they happen, and do they seem seasonal or triggered by allergies (pollen, pets, dust, smoke)?
They happen pretty often—maybe a few times a year. They seem to be triggered by allergies, like pollen or dust, and sometimes pets.
10) Do you have itchy eyes, sneezing, or symptoms that are worse when you’re around pollen/dust?
Yes, I get itchy eyes and sneezing. And my symptoms are worse around pollen and dust.
11) Any history of hives, lip/tongue swelling, or generalized itching, or is it only the nose/throat?
No hives or lip/tongue swelling. It’s mostly just the nose and the back of my throat that feel itchy.
12) Any wheezing at all, or does the cough ever come in fits, especially at night?
No wheezing. The cough isn’t in fits and it’s not especially worse at night.
13) Have you had any heartburn/reflux symptoms (burning in chest, sour taste), especially when lying down?
No heartburn or reflux symptoms.
14) Any red flags: severe sore throat, drooling, inability to swallow, stridor, or high fever?
No red flags like that. No severe sore throat, no drooling, and no high fever.
[DDX] Acute laryngitis, Viral pharyngitis, URTI, Acute rhinosinusitis, Bronchitis
